title: Serotonin neurons in the dorsal raphe control food-craving-like behavior during pregnancy in mice
title_zh: 小鼠妊娠期间背丘脑5-羟色胺神经元控制类食欲行为
abstract: During pregnancy, physiological changes can alter food intake behaviors. However, the underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear. Here we show that female mice exhibit food-craving-like behavior during pregnancy, mirroring many patterns described in humans. We show that 5-HTDRN neuronal firing activity is reduced during pregnancy through increased small-conductance calcium-activated potassium type 3 (SK3) ion-channel activity. Genetic knockout of SK3 ion channels from 5-HTDRN neurons abolishes the pregnancy-associated suppression in 5-HTDRN neuronal firing activity and reduces food-craving-like behavior in pregnant mice. Conversely, overexpression of SK3 in 5-HTDRN neurons mimics pregnancy-induced food-craving-like behavior in virgin female mice. Moreover, activation of 5-HTDRN projections to ventral tegmental area inhibits food-craving-like behavior in pregnant mice. These findings provide novel insights into the role of 5-HT signaling in modulating food cravings during pregnancy and highlight potential targets for managing pregnancy-associated appetite dysregulation and maternal obesity in humans. Zhao, Feng, Dong and colleagues found that pregnant mice crave highly palatable foods due to SK3-mediated inhibition of 5-HT neurons in DRN. Reactivating serotonergic DRN→VTA projections reduced these cravings and may provide new approaches to prevent maternal obesity.
abstract_zh: 妊娠期间，生理变化可能改变食物摄入行为。然而，其背后的神经机制尚不清楚。本研究显示，雌性小鼠在妊娠期间表现出类似人类的类食欲行为。我们发现，妊娠期间5-HTDRN神经元的放电活性通过大钙激活钾离子通道3（SK3）的活性增加而降低。从5-HTDRN神经元中敲除SK3离子通道会消除妊娠相关的5-HTDRN神经元放电活性抑制，并降低妊娠小鼠的类食欲行为。相反，在5-HTDRN神经元中过表达SK3会在处女雌性小鼠中模拟妊娠诱导的类食欲行为。此外，激活5-HTDRN通向腹侧被盖区的投射可在妊娠小鼠中抑制类食欲行为。这些发现提供了关于5-羟色胺信号在调节妊娠期间食欲渴望中作用的新见解，并突出了管理妊娠相关的食欲失调和产妇肥胖的潜在靶点。赵峰等人发现，妊娠小鼠因SK3介导的DRN 5-羟色胺神经元抑制而渴望高可口食物。恢复5-HT DRN→VTA投射可降低这些渴望，并可能为预防产妇肥胖提供新途径。
